items.statement: The investigation identifies converged stationary points and validates transition-state character and endpoint connectivity for the compared routes.
items.expected: A candidate-by-candidate table includes convergence, one-imaginary-mode TS classification where applicable, and IRC/equivalent endpoint evidence.

items.statement: The O-O-cleavage-first route has an O-O cleavage barrier near the published electronic result.
items.expected: The reported cleavage barrier is approximately 13.1 kcal/mol relative to 1RC.

items.statement: The subsequent HAT step from the oxo/oxyl intermediate has a lower barrier near the published electronic result.
items.expected: The reported HAT barrier is approximately 9.2 kcal/mol relative to 1RC.

items.statement: Direct HAT is substantially higher than the O-O-cleavage-first first barrier in the authors' TPSSH comparison.
items.expected: The direct-HAT barrier is reported as higher than the O-O-cleavage barrier; the SI TPSSH value is 27.64 kcal/mol.
